admission.justification: Refusing retired authoring POSTs before their handlers prevents a second authoring path from starting sessions or overwriting the explainer environment.

applicability: Serving app route registration order for old authoring POSTs and the new explainer composition.
conditions: The retired POST refusal is registered before canvas routes.
New explainer route wiring requires the supplied host and application ports.
exclusions: Retained revision/session reads, which keep serving.
Any process, session or publication credit from the retired POST.
statement: The explainer is the only current authoring route: each retired canvas Generate, regenerate, publish, cancel, replace and attempt-operation POST returns canvas-authoring-replaced before starting any process, opening a session or writing. Retained frame/revision/session reads remain available; missing native host or application composition refuses explainer routes by name rather than claiming a seat.
